propositions: The context window check in wire_history_processor only examines ModelResponse messages with failed output, never executing the guard on a first request where history is [ModelRequest].

An oversized first request (3.6M chars vs 1M token window) passes through without validation and surfaces to the provider as a 400 error, then re-types to LLMUnavailableError with provider-outage semantics instead of ContextWindowExceededError.
The seam requires a local token estimator calibrated at 4 chars/token (matching det_floor) to keep enrich's window*2-char bound admissible while catching gross overflows.

Three design decisions must precede implementation: calibration constant, fail-closed vs catchable posture per op class, and whether per-op bounds defer to the shared seam or remain as first-line bounds.
